capabilities: Insert citations and bibliographies from Zotero into notes
Import Zotero notes into the vault
Require and connect to the Better BibTeX plugin in Zotero
extras: Full documentation lives outside the README and is described as incomplete; the author asks for help with it. The README includes troubleshooting for install, loading, and citation errors.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull citations, bibliographies, or PDF annotations from a reference manager, so Zotero users must copy content manually.

relations.evidence: Insert and import citations, bibliographies, notes, and PDF annotations from Zotero into Obsidian.
Requires the Better BibTeX for Zotero plugin.

summary: Integration that inserts citations and bibliographies and imports notes and PDF annotations from Zotero into Obsidian.
